# Visionary Eyecare

> Independent optical shop at OUG Parklane, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia (near Old Klang Road), with an in-house optometrist and optician and 20 years of optical experience.

## Key facts
- Services: eye examinations by an in-house optometrist (done on-site), prescription spectacles fitted by an optician (specialising in Tokai prescription lenses, made to order and imported directly from Japan), lens edging (done in 30 minutes), frames and sunglasses, contact lenses, fittings and adjustments, kids' eyecare.
- 16 frame and sunglass brands: AKONI, PROJEKT PRODUKT, MOVITRA, RAY-BAN, ARMANI EXCHANGE, TOMMY HILFIGER, OAKLEY, FILA, AGNÈS B., NEW BALANCE, P+US, GUY LAROCHE, CARPE DIEM, HUMARS, MASARATA, MASUNAGA.
- Exclusive in the area: AKONI, PROJEKT PRODUKT and MOVITRA.
- Premium and affordable: alongside the premium labels, a wide range of affordable frames, some under RM100.
- Contact lenses: Alcon, CooperVision, Johnson & Johnson, Bausch + Lomb, Bionics, Manxion and FreshLady (Buy 3 Free 1 on selected Bionics Color Touch, Manxion and FreshLady).
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday 10:00am to 8:30pm; Sunday 10:30am to 6:00pm.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +60 12-948 9141 (https://wa.me/60129489141).
- Email: smvisionn81@gmail.com
- Address: D3-0-27, OUG Parklane, Jalan 1/152, 58200 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
- Reviews: rated 5.0 from 2,509 Google reviews (October 2026).
- Google reviews: https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/g/11l4mzqmr8&q=Visionary+Eyecare+Oug+Parklane
